action: Bank and Lynn in alternating close-ups - he against a pale wall, she among shelves - held on each other through a tense exchange. The window sits between B72 (01:49:20, Lynn brought back and Bank in the next room saying he does not know her) and the Bangkok arrival at B73 (01:51:30), and these are that beat's two characters, so this is the tail of the denial scene. The editorial point is the cutting: thirteen seconds in a film whose median shot is three, and every second of it is one face or the other, never both. Whatever passes between them here passes across a cut, with the camera refusing to put them in the same frame. At this point that denial is Bank taking the fall - R2 does not land until 01:58:45 - so a writer using this shot keeps it as the one who paid the worst price covering for her, and reads nothing into it from what comes later. It is also the last exchange between these two before the laundry at 01:57:20; everything in between is airport, her father, and a party she is not at. The beat map does not say what room any of this happens in - the wall and the shelves are pass one's and are left as seen.
